metric_defs.ceiling: directed F1 of the true graph's equivalence class under the orientation rule
metric_defs.directed_f1: F1 over directed edges; undecided pairs oriented by the stated rule
metric_defs.direction_accuracy: share of committed directions on true adjacencies that are right
metric_defs.skeleton_f1: F1 over unordered adjacencies of the skeleton

controls.knowledge_source: oracle tiers taken from the true graph (upper bound, not a method)
